title: Signal engine: per-capture feature append (DRAFT): for every new complete capture write quotes/<capture>.parquet (slim status + bid/ask of every binary market), features/<capture>.parquet (eligible markets; market state, momentum, flow, book, Kalshi gap, wallet families; float32) and meta/<capture>.json, write-once; no network; exit 75 when nothing is new
expected_value: the engine's own durable feature store (independent of the 8-day snapshot retention); input to every refit, prediction and label
data: research_lab/book_sweeps, trade_samples, cross_venue_live/quotes (read-only inputs; no outcome or prediction file of any E-test is read)
next_action: runs indefinitely (one productive run per capture; idle runs exit 75 and wait 30 min)
notes: DRAFT (signal engine v1, docs/research_lab/signal_engine/DESIGN_V1.md section 9). Measured on the host 2026-10-20 23:26-23:45Z in a read-only dry run (/tmp/sigeng, engine root outside ~/arepo, deleted afterwards). One capture 6.8-10 s, peak RSS 359-408 MB (single capture) / 488 MB (24-capture backfill) under a 1.2 GB address-space cap; files 2.5 MB features + 0.85 MB quotes per capture (~40 MB/day). The first runs backfill every capture still on the host (oldest first, 2 per run, re-queued at once). mem_mb 480 keeps it outside the 02:45-05:30 start blackout (the 02:31 and 04:31 captures would otherwise lose their 2 h predictions). PREFERRED ALTERNATIVE (owner/coordinator decision): one `tick` line in scripts/oracle/arepo_pass.sh after sample_trades (adds ~40 s per pass), which guarantees timeliness independent of queue lanes; then this job and q0511 are not needed. depends_on is empty on purpose: the other engine jobs are repeat jobs that never reach 'done'; missing inputs make this job exit 75 or report 'insufficient'/'no_fit' instead.
